message: More of my students in FYComp at the community college were headed for the 4-Year schools than not. Worth mentioning, however, is the fact that only those in the "transfer" divisions took FY comp. This, for me, was where the real divide came in: those who were headed for more school had comp classes; those enrolled in the explicitly vocational programs (culinary arts/hospitality/etc.) had, I suppose, their own writing requirements, but they were never in any of my classes.
